proposals.lexicon_quote: GERALD R FORD CI NUC AIRCRAFT CARRIER CVN 78-80	0604112N	340	Gerald R. Ford Class Nuclear Aircraft Carrier (CVN 78 - 80)
proposals.rationale: Rejected by design on the platform pattern — the announcement's own words are 'to support Ford Class aircraft carriers', i.e. spares for the platform, not work on the program element. The money color refutes it independently: the obligation is fiscal 2023 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) while 0604112N is an RDT&E PE (doc 340), and the index's SCN carrier lines (2001 Carrier Replacement Program, 2004 CVN-81, 2086 CVN Refueling Overhauls) carry no Ford-class name this announcement uses. A spare-rotor buy is sustainment, not the PE's development work.

proposals.announcement_evidence: the incorporation of additional work items in support of the ongoing Combat System Availability for DDG 1002
proposals.lexicon_quote: DDG 1002	0947	333	DDG 1000 Class Support Equipment
proposals.rationale: Rejected by design: 'DDG 1002' is a hull number, not a program — the index carries it only as a hull the DDG 1000 Class Support Equipment line references, so linking on it asserts nothing about that line's own work. The money color refutes it too: the obligation is fiscal 2023 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) while BLI 0947 sits in the OPN J-book (doc 333), and the SCN line for the class is 2119, which carries no hull-number name. The action itself is added work items inside a combat system availability, i.e. an availability scope growth.

proposals.announcement_evidence: littoral combat ship fleet maintenance sustainment support
proposals.lexicon_quote: Littoral Combat Ship (LCS)	2127	341	Littoral Combat Ship
proposals.rationale: Rejected by design twice over: the named thing is the platform the task order supports, and the scope — 'fleet maintenance sustainment support' performed through nationwide subcontractors and original equipment manufacturers — is the generic-sustainment-services pattern, not the shipbuilding line's own construction work. The name also collides between 2127 (SCN Littoral Combat Ship) and 0603581N (RDT&E Littoral Combat Ship (LCS)), with nothing in the announcement to resolve which; the reference to the BOA's original construction purpose is background, not the funded action.

proposals.program_name: F-18E/F and EA-18G Modernization and Sustainment
proposals.announcement_evidence: physiological episodes on the F/A-18A-F and EA-18G aircraft
proposals.lexicon_quote: F-18E/F and EA-18G Modernization and Sustainm
proposals.rationale: Rejected by design on the platform pattern: the only index-carried name in the evidence is the aircraft type, and the announcement never names a program — it describes investigating physiological episodes and fielding inspections and modifications across the fleet. The scope also spans F/A-18A-D legacy Hornets, which this line does not fund (the index puts legacy F-18 Series under 0525), so even the platform reference is broader than the candidate line. A fleet-wide aircrew-safety investigation is not the modernization line's own procurement content.

proposals.announcement_evidence: engineering and technical support services and deliverable materials for the TRIDENT II Fleet Ballistic Missile System
proposals.lexicon_quote: TRIDENT II Mods	1250	342	Trident II Mods
proposals.rationale: Rejected by design on the generic-services pattern: the deliverable is engineering and technical support services — 'technical planning, direction, coordination, and control' plus resident technical support — for a weapon system, with no modification program named. It is also explicitly work performed for a foreign government ('to provide the United Kingdom (UK) with ...', supporting UK Fleet Ballistic Missile Program requirements), so it does not execute the U.S. Trident II Mods line's own work, and the announcement names the missile system rather than the Mods line the index carries.

proposals.announcement_evidence: for the procurement of three LM2500 Paired Blade Turbine High Pressure Turbine (HPT) kits and two Single Shank Turbine HPT kits
proposals.lexicon_quote: LM2500 DIGITAL FUEL CONTROL (DFC)	0131	333	Surface Power Equipment
proposals.rationale: The only index name in play matches on the engine family, not the item: the Surface Power Equipment line's narrative owns the LM2500 Digital Fuel Control, whereas this order buys high pressure turbine kits — a different component, so the shared 'LM2500' string is an engine-name coincidence rather than the program. The money color refutes it independently: the whole $19,324,546 is fiscal 2022 operation and maintenance (Navy) that will expire at the end of the fiscal year, i.e. O&M sustainment charged against an OPN line (doc 333), which is the failure mode the held-out study flagged.

proposals.announcement_evidence: for seven Multi-Spectral Targeting Systems (MTS) configuration
proposals.lexicon_quote: Mobile Tactical Shelter (MTS)	4733	339	Fire Support System
proposals.rationale: Rejected as a bare-acronym collision: the announcement's MTS is the Multi-Spectral Targeting System, 'an airborne, electro-optic, forward-looking infra-red, turreted sensor package', while the only index row carrying MTS is a Mobile Tactical Shelter in the Marine Corps Fire Support System line — different domain, different appropriation (this award obligates fiscal 2016 aircraft procurement (Navy) against a PMC-book line, doc 339). The expanded name Multi-Spectral Targeting System appears nowhere in this org's index, so the record has no genuine candidate and the three-letter overlap must not be allowed to publish.
